pilot.interpretation: Pilot continuation gate only; final source acceptance still needs the charter gates and matrix.

limitations: Six pilot samples per action and variant; this is a continuation decision, not final p95 target acceptance.
Open samples are fresh processes, not OS-cold. All first-use outliers are retained; order/cache variance prevents a general Open speedup claim.
Non-IPC interval includes all UI handling, rendering, frames and waits; it is not directly measured paint.
Initial-EADDRINUSE and zero-sample manifest-wiring failures remain separate from this valid series.
